parameters.content:
## 🚀 Stealth Breakout & Investor Radar
Tracks live operational growth signals before funding rounds are announced:
1. **ATS Hiring Spikes**: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable open jobs.
2. **Active Google Ads Spend**: Running campaigns from Google Ads Transparency Center.
3. **Tech Stack & Contacts**: Pixel tracking & public company contacts.
4. **Breakout Scoring**: 0–100 signal score for instant VC/B2B alerts.

### 1. Shortlist Input
Enter target domains in Settings.
Free sandbox domains: linear.app, stripe.com, vercel.com.

### 2. Operational Intelligence
Cross-checks hiring velocity, live Google Ads, and tech stack in parallel via HirePulse profile API.

### 3. Investor Alerts & Routing
Filters breakouts (score >= 60) for actionable alerts, and flags quota/edge cases.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: trial_token: optional. Get 25 free calls with POST https://gethirepulse.xyz/v1/trial {"email":"you@company.com"} or {"wallet":"0x..."}. Demo domains (example.com, linear.app, stripe.com, shopify.com, vercel.com) are always free. With a trial_token, each other domain uses a trial call; without one, it uses one of the 5 free daily calls.

const list = String($input.first().json.domains || '').replace(/[,;]/g, ' ').split(' ').map(d => d.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
return [...new Set(list)].map(domain => ({ json: { domain } }));
